verdict.rationale: Statsig's docs say Feature Gates change behavior in real time without deploying new code, and that features can be rolled out gradually via Scheduled Rollouts. They also say evaluation is deterministic, returning the same result for the same user across client and server, which gives consistent bucketing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of percentage-based pass rates and ramp steps (e.g. 1%→100%) for gates, and independent or hands-on corroboration of progressive rollouts.
